description: Acknowledgement templates. Placeholders in braces are filled by the prototype. Edit wording here; no code change needed.

category_notes.Access & Permissions: Access requests are checked against our data protection and information security policies before access is granted. We may contact you to confirm the business need and the approving manager.
category_notes.Process Automation: A member of the team will review the current process with you to confirm the trigger, the steps to automate and who should be notified.
category_notes.Reporting & Analytics: We will confirm the data sources, the measures you need and how often the report or dashboard should refresh.
category_notes.System Integration: Integration requests are assessed for data ownership, security and supportability before design work starts.
category_notes.Content & Guidance: We will agree the audience, structure and content owner with you before anything is published.
category_notes.Uncategorised: We could not automatically determine the type of your request, so a member of the team will review it and contact you if we need more detail.

incomplete_note: Some required information was missing or invalid ({missing_fields}). A member of the team will contact you to complete it before work can begin.
